svg.title: AIOps Ansible Software Factory architecture
svg.desc: Nested OpenShift logical service groups, separate virtualized RHEL production hosts and fresh RHEL 9 and 10 acceptance hosts, with external GitHub, inference and Lightwell inputs.

text.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Shared OpenShift management plane, two independent RHEL applications, and fresh real-machine acceptance tests

text.tspan: OpenShift Container Platform — demo management plane

text.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Logical service groups; not worker placement, availability zones, or an HA topology

text.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Virtualized guest zone — dedicated network segment

text.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: RHEL application and test VMs; provider may differ from the OpenShift cluster

text.tspan: Agent Molecule and trusted AAP acceptance use separate owned lifecycles.
Test guests are destroyed; interrupted cleanup retains ownership records.

text.font-family: Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
Arial, Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: AAP provisions each application with separate purpose and network access.
OpenShift Services + EndpointSlices provide stable guest endpoints.
Scoped Molecule identity manages only disposable test resources.
Reset removes application/test guests and disks; network is retained.

Inference runs outside this demo management plane.

Ansible discovery uses standard modules, including uri.
